brief.notes: B2B supplier of aircraft maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO) parts. Targeting airline procurement managers and MRO engineers — this is an industrial B2B audience, not leisure flyers.

labels.labeler_note: Near-miss trap named directly after the guide's own example: 'Aviation (air travel)' (the B2B industry interest, correct) vs. 'Air travel (transportation)' (the consumer leisure-travel interest, tempting keyword match but the wrong audience for an MRO parts supplier) -> must_exclude.
